newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Puleva to propose free capital issues.
newsitem.headline: Spain Puleva to propose free capital issues.

text.p: Spain's Puleva Uniasa will propose free capital issues for 1997, 1998 and 1999, a statement presented to the stock exchange commission (CNMV) said on Wednesday.
Under the first issue, charged over 1996 results, shareholders would receive one new share for every five old shares. The new shares would have the same rights as the old ones as of January 1, 1997.
The second issue would give shareholders one new share for four old, while the third issue would give one new share for every three old.
The issues are to be presented to shareholders at the next meeting on May 23.
Puleva said it would also pay a premium of five pesetas per share to shareholders attending the meeting.
